Multi-start SLSQP on (x, y, r) maximising the sum of radii, with analytic Jacobians. It alternates random restarts and perturbation of the best solution (basin hopping), then does an LP polish of the radii and a tiny safety shrink so the packing is strictly feasible.

Multi-start SLSQP on (x, y, r) with analytic Jacobians, maximising the sum of radii under pair and wall constraints. Multi-start SLSQP that maximises the sum of radii over (x, y, r) with analytic Jacobians. Starts are random and hex-like, followed by basin-hopping perturbations of the best solution. A final exact pass shrinks radii so the result is feasible.
